sentences.text:
Opp. Parties
 Mrs. Sasmita Nayak, Asc
 Coram:
 Justice Sibo Sankar Mishra
Order Order
 No. 11.11.2024
 01. 1.

This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual/Physical Mode).
2.

3. The petitioner is challenging the order dated 28.01.2022 passed by the learned J.M.F.C.,
Lamtaput at Koraput in G.R. Case No.49 of 2021, whereby cognizance of offences punishable under Sections 376 (2)(n)/417/341/323/324/294/34 of the IPC, has been taken against the her.
4.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the allegation made in the charge sheet and material form part of the charge sheet even if is accepted to be true, no case under the provision of Section 376(2)(n) could be made out.
5.
I am not inclined to entertain this petition at this cognizance stage.
However, liberty is granted to the petitioner to raise all the points before the learned Court below at appropriate stage.
6. With this liberty, the CRLMC is disposed of.
(S.S. Mishra) Judge amit Location: HIGH COURT OF ORISSA, CUTTACK Priti Hantal @ Priti Kumari vs State Of Odisha & Another ....
